description: This file defines the PocketAccountMappingRepositoryWrapper class, which acts as a wrapper around the persistence layer for managing PocketAccountMapping entities. It provides methods to save, delete, and retrieve mappings between pocket accounts and accounts within the Fineract portfolio module.

classes.name: PocketAccountMappingRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates interactions with the PocketAccountMappingRepository, providing methods to manage pocket account mappings with added exception handling for missing associations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a single PocketAccountMapping entity to the repository.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a list of PocketAccountMapping entities to the repository and returns the saved list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list of PocketAccountMapping entities from the repository.

methods.name: findByIdAndPocketIdWithNotFoundException
methods.description: Retrieves a PocketAccountMapping by its id and pocketId, throws an exception if not found or not linked properly.

methods.name: findByPocketId
methods.description: Finds all PocketAccountMappings associated with a specific pocketId.
